paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Financial QA-1 evaluation.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three models on a task labeled "QA-1", with each bar representing the accuracy classification into "Correct", "Partially Correct", and "Incorrect". The categories are displayed on the vertical axis, which is labeled with the names of the models: "Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B", "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", and "RedWhale (our)." The horizontal axis unlabelled, without specific tick interval markings. Each model is represented by a horizontally stacked bar divided into three segments, colored to correspond with "Correct" (dark purple), "Partially Correct" (medium purple), and "Incorrect" (light blue). The "Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B" model bar has values of approximately 0.88 for "Correct", 0.08 for "Partially Correct", and 0.04 for "Incorrect". The "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" and "RedWhale (our)" models both show values of 0.96 for "Correct" and 0.04 for "Incorrect", with no value for "Partially Correct". The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no visual emphases such as shading or outlining applied to any bars. A legend is given bottom.
